model: Code-native, photo-guided Škoda/Transtech Artic reconstruction in src/tram-model.js (rendered by src/trams.js); not a manufacturer CAD model or exact replica
referenceUse: Manufacturer photographs viewed as visual references only; not embedded or redistributed in the game

routes.adaptation: Most frequent active shape per selected line/direction, projected and clipped to the demo area

limitations: Route shapes are not surveyed track centres
Switch geometry and overhead wiring are simplified
Stops are spatially matched, not timetable stop sequences
Motion, waiting times and priorities are simulated, not live HSL operations
Visible terminus turning loops are not implemented
referencePhotos: Street-level photography, Kanavakatu, Aug 2024, Artic #429 on line 4 (viewed for proportions and livery only; no pixels embedded)
